item.title: Wind back 10, the 'AI' I Never Knew I Was
item.description: Remember 2015? Ah, those halcyon days! We were all still figuring out what “the cloud” really meant for us, wondering if smartwatches would ever really take off, and frankly, blissfully unaware of how much AI was about to reshape our world. Well, recently, I stumbled down a rabbit hole of my own making, dusting off some old blog posts from that very year. And honestly? What I found was both enlightening and perhaps even a little bit alarming.
